ModMetaData.name: Battle Formations
ModMetaData.author: CICADRAZA
ModMetaData.description:
Ancient and medieval battle formations for drafted colonists.
Draft your colonists (R), click the formation button and pick one of 18 historical formations: - Antiquity: phalanx, maniples (quincunx), triplex acies, testudo, orbis, oblique order, crescent, sparabara - Middle Ages: shield wall, wedge (svinfylking), schiltron, herse, Swiss square (Gewalthaufen), tercio - General: double line, column, scattered line, L-ambush
Every formation fights differently: some hold their ground, some charge, relieve wounded front fighters, fall back as skirmishers or wait in ambush. No stat bonuses: a formation is just a formation. The info card shows the tactic and the history: origin, period and famous battles.
Click to place, or drag to draw the front line (width and facing, 8 directions). Roles (pikes, melee, ranged) are assigned from the weapons and can be changed.
Placed groups become regiments: a normal right-click move order marches the whole regiment in formation. Select regiments from the bar below the colonist bar or with F1-F5.
Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean.
No dependencies. Safe to add to existing saves.
